title: It's OK, but could be better & too pricey for the quality
text:
It's OK, but could be better & too pricey for the quality. I purchased 4 white bookshelves (2 from Amazon and 2 from Walmart - Mainstays). I wanted only 2, but ended up with 3. Keep reading for the 'why'.

I purchased the Amazon (Furinno) ones first and quickly assembled one, but after finishing it, I was less than satisfied. It's the little things. The backboard was folded outward so the creases are more visible, which isn't good for a white bookshelf. Also, the shelf spacing is awkward. I decided to wait to assemble #2 and went to Plan B: Walmart bookshelves. (The sizes of the two products are within about an inch of each other on the measurements.) I figured I'd assemble a shelf and compare the two.

I was very satisfied with the Mainstays bookshelf because of the little things: 1) back panel folding was inward so the creases are more subtle, 2) the shelf spacing isn't so awkward, 3) little white caps were included to cover screws and cam locks, 4) all sides of the boards were covered white (expect the one facing the wall) including the top and bottom boards, and 5) very easy to assemble, clearly labeled parts, and clear instructions.

Finally, and this is the clencher for me, the price point for Mainstays is $29.88 (as of 4/25/21 in stores), whereas the Furinno shelves are nearly $60. The cheaper product looks better. I returned the unopened Furinno, but kept the one already assembled (too much trouble to disassemble and send back while also paying the $30 shipping costs). I'll use it in a less visible place. Now I have 3 shelves.

The Mainstays are in my living room and look lovely. They're certainly not genuine wood, but they are well made especially for the price.

Why 3 stars if I haven't said many positives about the product? The product is average at best, but Furrino's service is excellent - the shelves arrived 4 days ahead of the projected date, which I was very happy with, and they refunded my money for the one bookshelf, minus the shipping costs. But the product could be better, especially for the cost.
